items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Bob Haggart, yeah, right, playing bass with him

ctx.x: Bob Haggart, yeah, right, playing bass with him, and then Sharky Bananas had his band. So we went down there and we played on the boat, and whats' name, George Brunis was with us, yeah. But it was really amazing, to see these people bringing food, and I saw the biggest tambourine I've ever seen in my life -- about that big.
